text:
Situation: Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company, has a calcium chloride injection entry on the FDA shortage list with status To Be Discontinued and an initial posting date of 2025-11-07. FDA's drug shortage list does not include calcium chloride as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East has 29.4 days on hand (459 units) and Corvale General has 16.2 days on hand (245 units) for the 100 mg/mL 10 mL syringe presentation.

Why (FDA record): The label for NDC 00409163110 names Hospira, Inc. as the registered plant (FEI 1021343) with a last inspection classified NAI on 2025-02-07. FDA inspection records for that plant show multiple OAI classifications in 2010 and 2011, followed by VAI classifications through 2019. A Warning Letter was issued to Hospira, Inc. on 2010-04-12.

Our position: We must secure alternative supply before Hospira inventory is exhausted. Current stock covers approximately 16 to 29 days depending on site. No other manufacturer appears on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with American Regent, Inc. (needs: buyer approval).
2. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC (needs: buyer approval).
3. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Civica, Inc. (needs: buyer approval).
4. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Inc. (needs: buyer approval).
5. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Eskayef Pharmaceuticals Limited (needs: buyer approval).

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol modifications at this time; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
